findings.evidence: Step 1.2 bounds the integrand below by e^(-1)t^(-1) and concludes divergence by a lower comparison. The cited [F2], thm-comparison-test-for-improper-integrals, states only the upper-bound convergence direction; it does not supply the lower-bound divergence implication. Close the gap with a truncated-integral argument, such as integral from ε to 1 of t^(s-1)e^(-t) being at least e^(-1)log(1/ε), or cite a divergence comparison theorem.
